# rabbitmq-operator-blueprint

Krateo blueprints for the RabbitMQ cluster-operator (v2.23.2) and messaging-topology-operator (v1.20.5). Each upstream
release manifest is vendored unchanged and rendered by a chart with a short, gated list of changes. Published to
oci://ghcr.io/krateo-blueprints/charts/rabbitmq-cluster-operator and .../rabbitmq-topology-operator on the blueprints
channel, each with its CompositionDefinition inside the archive.

## Shape
- blueprints/<chart>/chart: Chart.yaml, values.yaml, values.schema.json, files/upstream/<asset>, templates/.
- blueprints/<chart>/compositiondefinition.yaml: the CompositionDefinition, stamped at release.
- hack/upstream.yaml: the upstream repo, tag, asset, SHA-256, image, container and required CRDs per chart.

## Render-time changes to upstream
- no Namespace object; rabbitmq-system becomes the release namespace;
- helm.sh/resource-policy: keep on every CRD;
- operator Deployment: replicas, image, pull policy, pod anti-affinity, resources, nodeSelector, tolerations from values;
- a PodDisruptionBudget (maxUnavailable 1) with more than one replica.

## Preconditions
- cert-manager's CRDs, from any source (Krateo: the installer's features.ingress); both charts refuse without them.
- The topology chart also refuses without rabbitmqclusters.rabbitmq.com (install the cluster-operator first).

## Versioning
- Both charts share the repository version, stamped from the tag; appVersion is the upstream version.
- Kinds RabbitmqClusterOperator and RabbitmqTopologyOperator, served at composition.krateo.io/v<X-Y-Z>.
- hack/release-preflight refuses a tag the examples do not name.
- Pre-releases: dispatch prerelease.yaml with a ref; X.Y.Z-main.g<sha7> (-dev. off main) to GHCR plus a run artifact
  with the stamped CompositionDefinitions and examples; never in the Marketplace index (docs/release.md).

## Docs
- docs/index.md, docs/overview.md, docs/usage.md, docs/configuration.md, docs/api.md, docs/examples.md,
  docs/release.md, docs/log.md
